title: Rider and Driver Support Voice Agent
summary: A Hindi and regional-language voice agent for delivery riders and truck drivers that handles address help, trip, payout and COD queries, and captures incidents for immediate control tower handover.

seo.title: Rider and Driver Support Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: Voice agent for riders and truck drivers in Hindi and regional languages: address help, payouts, COD and incidents, with control tower handover.

designed_for: Head of Fleet and Rider Operations

problem.intro: Last-mile riders and line-haul drivers call hubs, team leads and control towers all day: the address cannot be found, the customer is not answering, the app shows the wrong payout, the vehicle has broken down. Callers are on the road, often prefer Hindi or a regional language, and need answers fast, while control tower staff juggle the same questions across many phones.

pain_points.title: Repetitive queries clog the helpline
pain_points.detail: Payout, incentive, COD deposit and app login questions take up agent time needed for real incidents.

pain_points.title: Long waits on the road
pain_points.detail: Riders waiting for help at a customer's door, or drivers stuck at a checkpost, lose time and deliveries.

pain_points.title: Incidents reported inconsistently
pain_points.detail: Accidents, breakdowns, thefts and detentions are reported by phone, and details are lost before they reach the right team.

pain_points.title: Language and literacy gaps
pain_points.detail: Text-based in-app support does not suit riders and drivers who are more comfortable speaking in their own language.

solution.overview: We build a voice agent that riders and drivers reach from a helpline number or a button in their app. It identifies the caller by phone number, loads their current trip or route, and handles common questions directly: consignee contact attempts and address landmarks, payout and incentive breakdowns, COD deposit status and app troubleshooting. For breakdowns, accidents, theft or detentions it collects location and key details in a fixed sequence and transfers to a control tower agent at once with a summary. It speaks Hindi, Hinglish and the regional languages you need, and never changes payouts or trip assignments itself.
capabilities: Identifies the rider or driver and loads their active trip, route and recent payouts
Answers payout, incentive, COD deposit and app login questions from your systems
Helps with address issues using landmarks, consignee contact attempts and hub guidance
Collects structured incident reports for breakdowns, accidents, theft and detentions
Transfers urgent and safety-related calls to a control tower agent with a summary
Works in Hindi, Hinglish and configured regional languages on noisy roadside audio

workflow.title: Rider or driver calls
workflow.detail: The caller uses the helpline number or app button and is identified by phone number.

workflow.title: Classify the issue
workflow.detail: The agent asks what is wrong and classifies it as a query, address help or an incident.

workflow.title: Answer from systems
workflow.detail: For queries, it fetches trip, payout or COD data from your systems and explains it.

workflow.title: Capture incidents
workflow.detail: For incidents, it captures location, vehicle, shipment and injury information in a fixed sequence.

workflow.title: Hand over when needed
workflow.detail: Safety issues, disputes and unresolved queries go to a control tower agent with the summary.

workflow.title: Log and follow up
workflow.detail: Each call is logged with its outcome, and tickets are created for teams such as payouts or claims.

inputs: Rider and driver master with phone numbers and preferred languages
Active trips, routes and consignment details
outputs: Warm transfers to the control tower with context
Tickets for payouts, claims or fleet teams
Call reason analytics by hub and language
human_in_the_loop: Control tower staff take over every safety incident, dispute and unresolved call, with the agent's summary on screen. Payout corrections, trip reassignments and claims decisions are made by your teams.
integrations: Ticketing system such as Freshdesk or Zendesk
WhatsApp Business API for follow-up messages
guardrails: Safety-related phrases trigger an immediate human transfer
No changes to payouts, trips or COD records by the agent
Callers can ask for a person at any point
Personal data shared only with the verified caller
Weekly sampled call reviews for answer quality
compliance_notes: Call recordings and rider or driver data are processed in line with the DPDP Act 2023, with notice at the start of the call.
Incident records support your duty-of-care and insurance processes; they do not replace statutory accident reporting.

pilot.scope: One city or region and its rider helpline, starting with payout and COD queries plus incident capture with immediate handover.
deliverables: Call flows for the agreed intents in Hindi and one regional language
Integration with trip and payout data
Pilot report on resolution and handover quality
Roll-out plan by language and region

faqs.q: Will riders actually use a voice agent?
faqs.a: Riders and drivers already call for help; the agent answers at once in their language and transfers when needed. The pilot measures repeat usage and transfer requests so you can judge acceptance.

faqs.q: How does it cope with traffic noise?
faqs.a: Speech recognition is tested on real roadside and highway audio during the pilot. If the agent still cannot understand after a retry, it transfers to a person rather than guessing.

faqs.q: Can it reassign a delivery or change an address?
faqs.a: It can pass address landmarks or reattempt requests to the hub, but it does not change assignments or records itself. Those actions stay with hub staff or your existing rules.
We start with Hindi and Hinglish and add regional languages such as Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada or Bengali based on your fleet. Each language is tested on real audio before go-live.
